HANGS Construction Services IRS notice CP207, Q2 2026 Form 941

We received the attached IRS notice CP207 on October 29 for our Q2 2026 Form 941. It proposes a deposit penalty of $4,534.32 and says our return showed monthly liabilities instead of a Schedule B. Please work out whether the penalty is right and draft our reply. The notice is dated October 26, so we have 45 days.

Our payroll system deposits every regular payroll through EFTPS on the next business day after the payday; the EFTPS history and the return as filed are attached, and the payroll by payday, our employer details and the IRS account history are in the folder.

- The June 26 off-cycle bonus run (PR-2614, paid with the regular payroll that day) is not in the system's automatic EFTPS batch, and I did not schedule its deposit. I caught it in the July reconciliation and made the deposit myself on July 7.

- The payroll system's upgrade on May 4 reset its Form 941 setting from semiweekly to monthly. The Q1 return went in before that with a Schedule B; the Q2 return went in with the monthly box on line 16 and no Schedule B.
- The Q3 return is being prepared separately with a Schedule B. The setting in the system still says monthly.
